questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scientists have discovered evidence of abundant water-bearing minerals on the ______ of an asteroid Bennu.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**surface**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No improvement.

__Each of the guests were given__ a return gift.

options.text: Each of the guests was given
Each and every guest were given

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

**Each of the guests was given** a return gift.

In the given question, the pronoun **each** does not agree with the verb **were.** Pronouns like **each/anybody/everyone** are singular and they require a singular verb even when they are followed by a phrase which contains a plural noun like **of the guests**. So, instead of **were **, **was **will be used. 

So, options **1,3 and 4 **are **incorrect.**

questions.question:
**In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

Friction reduce the efficiency of machines so their value also gets reduced.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Friction reduce__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **'Friction reduces' **should be there in place of **'Friction reduce'**
 
• The **subject **and **verb** must agree with each other in a sentence. When the subject is singular, the verb used should be singular, and when the subject is plural, the verb used should be plural.
 
• Also with **uncountable nouns**, a **singular verb** is used.
 
 
• **Examples: **
 
 
• ***This** news **is** very important.*
 
• *Your luggage **looks** heavy.*
 
 
 
 
 
• 'Friction' is an uncountable noun. So singular verb should be used.
 
• **Thus, the correct sentence is:** *Friction **reduces** the efficiency of machines so their value also gets reduced.*

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. The disruptions began to annoy his teachers.

B. They were increasingly baffled by his questions.

C. Swami looked forward to disrupting every class.

D. They began to write notes in his handbook summoning his parents.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

The first statement should be ***Swami looked forward to disrupting every class**.* The first statement must give a slight idea about the context of the paragraph. Statements **B and D** start with **they,** which means they are in continuation with another statement.

Statement **A **mentions the third person form i.e **his**, but we do not get an idea about the subject of the sentence if **A** is made the first statement.

**Statement C** has the noun which can be the subject being spoken about.

So, options** 2,3 and 4 **are** incorrect.**

questions.question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The results will be known to us by the end of the next month.

options.text: We will know the results by the end of the next month.
We have known the results by the end of the next month.
We are knowing the results by the end of the next month.
We know the results by the end of the next month.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**We will know the results by the end of the next month.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and '**The results**' is the subject and '**us**' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject '**The results**' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object '**us**' becomes the subject ( subjective case of pronoun for us is 'we').
 
• The passive format "will + be + V3" should be changed into the active format "will + V1 ".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the future simple tense.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
 
•
